narrative.headline: Smart money is loading semis and AI-infrastructure plays while rotating out of semi-cap equipment, with a secondary bid in electrical/power names.
bullish_themes: Semiconductor design houses dominate the tape — NVDA, AMD, QCOM, INTC, AVGO all printing premium with bullish_pct above 0.78 and heavy ask-side prints
Communication Equipment / AI networking cluster — LITE, HPE, AAOI, VIAV — confirming the AI buildout trade beyond pure chips
Electrical Equipment & Parts (XLI crossover) showing 100% bullish flow in BE, TE, FPS, POWL — clean power/grid/data-center electrification theme
Sharp divergence within XLK: chip designers bid, semi-cap equipment (LRCX, AMAT, KLAC, ONTO) sold — flow is trading the demand side, not the capex side
notable_individual_flows: INTC: $35.5M premium at 93.7% bullish with 33 ask-side prints — institutional re-rating bet
NVDA: $25.1M premium at 96.9% bullish, 54 ask-side prints — relentless dominant flow
AMD: $38M premium at 82.3% bullish — largest single-name premium in the bullish bucket
BE: perfect 10.0 score, 100% bullish, 14 ask-side prints — cleanest signal in the scan
LRCX/AMAT/KLAC: coordinated bearish flow across all three semi-cap names — actionable contra-signal
narrative.absences: No bullish flow surfaced in software, mega-cap tech (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL), financials, energy, or healthcare despite broad scan coverage. Gold flow is mixed and low-premium (CDE bullish, NEM bearish) — not a real theme.
